name.description: Function-calling name. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores; must not be `run_terminal_command`.

description.description: What the tool does, in the words the model will read. This is prompt text on every turn, so keep it to a sentence or two.

params.description: The typed inputs the model fills in.

name.description: Parameter name, as the model will pass it.

type.description: One of string, integer, number, boolean.

description.description: What the model should put here.

required.description: Whether the model must supply a value.

default.description: Value used when the model omits an optional parameter.

template.description: A shell command with {param} placeholders. Interpolations are shell-quoted; use {param:raw} to insert a value literally.

timeout_ms.description: Kill the command after this many milliseconds. 0 means no timeout.

max_output.description: Cap stdout and stderr at this many bytes each. 0 uses the session default.
